notes.title: September Update - Preview!
notes.content:
Lords, Ladies, and People of the Realm!


We are excited to share with you our latest progress and update! As we continue working on the release of the Wildlands Update, we are planning to provide another patch with some core functionality changes along with new features. We will provide highlights to the new features which include overhaul of our Fuel System, Warmth, along with the new framing system workflow. In addition we have an expansive list of notes that improve AI Villagers, Navigation, Gameplay Systems, Events, and more. 

For more information feel free to join us in a deeper walkthrough of our September Update Highlights!

[previewyoutube="r5u4-hEfodo;full"][/previewyoutube][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/91985e6e8e9cdb4df658fbea5eb7b4d4bcd276bd.png"]
Highlights
New Feature: Builder’s Lodge 

The Builders Lodge built with the new Builders Tool Rack is a dedicated structure for the new Labourer job roles in which peasants assigned to labourer will construct your buildings for you!

New Feature: Labourer Role 

New Feature: Building Framing System

A new build system is in place with the all new building framing system - where you can plan out your structures in which frames are placed for your villagers to build. You can swap between preview modes by equipping and unequipping your hammer. 


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/6699b607c94705c9b27c8acea4c5ab944df06f9d.jpg"]

New Feature: Hearth (Warmth and Fuel Overhaul)

Warm and Fuel has been re-designed by requiring Hearths to be placed in villager homes to properly warm them. Villagers will automatically maintain their homes fuel level as long as your market storage is fed sufficient fuel.  



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/5d0f5f092870588f3f1e1aaf264eb846a54b331e.jpg"]

New Feature: Financial tracking

Financial breakdown available in kingdom menu

New Production Toggle: production furniture (e.g., forager’s basket) can now be enabled/disabled manually with Q.

Added new Halloween assets: scarecrow, gravestones, pumpkins, icons.

Expanded décor: new rugs, castle wall battlements, bookshelves, light posts, hearth, new crop visuals



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/83e92e8b764919fe3d75abfbf10471a05aee8df5.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/91985e6e8e9cdb4df658fbea5eb7b4d4bcd276bd.png"]
Community Spotlight


Created by Yule - there is no time wasted in crafting castles, and this mega village features narrow streets along with a massive stone castle looming over. 

Feel free to follow their progress here!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/dbb85c03644fa0ed35d4926db834822ad4e12afb.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/38da00713738417e714f5de696c158fccd23dff6.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/91985e6e8e9cdb4df658fbea5eb7b4d4bcd276bd.png"]  

Created by Bad Mojo - This town looks natural, warm, and inviting. With connected building styles, and very strong variations, this town is sure to be one to visit! Check out their walkthrough video here!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/66980dfcdf3f178943c664736c6e94d3abef0e16.jpg"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/91985e6e8e9cdb4df658fbea5eb7b4d4bcd276bd.png"]That is all for this September Preview - the update is slated to come very soon and we look forward to sharing our progress and update notes shortly.  Cheers, and see you in Greenwood!

notes.title: Community Update
notes.content:
Lords, Ladies, and People of the Realm!


We’re now three weeks into Early Access, and we are truly humbled by the incredible support from our community and friends here in Noble Legacy. Your contributions, feedback, and especially the dedication of our Discord Focus Testers have been invaluable in helping us refine the game through rapid hotfixes and content updates. We sincerely thank you for being a vital part of this journey. And what better way to celebrate than with a visit to the local tavern?  

We’re excited to introduce Heather, our newest Villager! Much like other tradespeople, she’s here to lend a hand in your settlement—but her true calling lies in tavern keeping. Please enjoy this free addition as a small token of our gratitude for your continued support.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/309a41a74a447e86bb92c7d4fcb3649530fc4730.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/91985e6e8e9cdb4df658fbea5eb7b4d4bcd276bd.png"]
Updated Roadmap and Long Term Vision


Due to the incredible response and observing players feedback as well as aligning our vision and goals with Noble Legacy, we have updated our roadmap to further communicate key systems that are coming and how they align with the long term vision of our game. 


Kingdom Mode

We’re placing our primary focus on Kingdom Mode, our flagship game mode, to ensure the systems and mechanics that drive the long-term gameplay loop are fully realized.

Kingdom Mode emphasizes endless replayability, balancing design and mechanics with punishing challenges—such as morale-driven riots, shifting loyalties after the Norman Conquest, and difficult choices around raids, taxation, and rival barons. Every decision, or lack thereof, can impact the long-term stability of your fiefdom.

The entire map of Greenwood plays into this vision. Villages will have unique resources, encouraging structured trade, while crafting systems will feature blacksmiths of varying rarities to produce diverse tools, weapons, and armor. Combined with royal demands and competition from simulated barons, players will face meaningful challenges in both economy and strategy.

With this shift in focus, we’ve updated our Roadmap accordingly.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/3d15f6226e2e25a2f8afbc5d4ea3cffebeb1446a.jpg"]Noble Legacy 2025 Roadmap

We’re moving the Wildlands Update forward to focus on core mechanics of the player’s caput. This update introduces wildlife—including wolves, boars, deer, and various fish—as part of our new minigame system. Tools are also being overhauled with full inventory integration and hotbar assignment. Maintaining and producing tools will now play a larger role in the economy, offering higher-tier equipment that improves villagers’ stats and efficiency.

Wildlands also refines farming with the addition of Animal Husbandry (pastures, the Shepherd role), and the much-anticipated Hunting Lodge with the Hunter role. Building mechanics will receive an overhaul as well, featuring a framing system where villagers can be assigned to construction through the new Construction Workshop.

Finally, players will gain the ability to construct their own Lord’s Manor, serving as the Baron’s beacon in their fiefdom.

Looking ahead, we’ve also moved the Life & Death Update up to winter. This update will overhaul combat mechanics, while introducing the Apothecary (Healer role), Bath House to prevent illness, the Lord’s Mount, and more.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/91985e6e8e9cdb4df658fbea5eb7b4d4bcd276bd.png"]

You have asked for it. Multiplayer Coop. 
Due to the overwhelming feedback and requests, we have decided to align on multiplayer coop which is slated for the Life & Death Update. We will have more details to come regarding specifics on multiplayer coop, but we can confirm that production has officially begun work.


New Localization: French & Russian
localisation en français / Новая локализация: русский
Based on player demand and community demographics, we are introducing localization for French and Russian. As development continues, new content and text will require ongoing updates, so we kindly ask for your patience as we expand and refine localization with each milestone.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/91985e6e8e9cdb4df658fbea5eb7b4d4bcd276bd.png"]
Incoming Patch for 9/5/2025

We are prepped to release a patch tomorrow - included are the following list of notes and changes

Recruitment & events:

Adjusted furniture and bookshelf collision boxes for easier decoration placement, including 3-shelf items.

Fixed decoration placement difficulty.


Art & visual fixes:

Art & Visual Improvements
Optimized materials, lighting, and post-processing for performance and visuals.

Optimized draw distances for resources, buildings, and mineshafts.

Optimized LOD distances for trees, shrubs, and other environmental assets.

Optimized all build part icons and UI assets to reduce overhead memory usage.

 And that's a wrap for this week! Thank you all again for your continued support, and we are excited to share further details as we get closer to releasing them! See you in Greenwood!

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.1.53999
notes.content:
Patch Notes 0.1.53999


This update addresses multiple issues from our first week of early access launch. Thanks to your feedback and assistance through launch, we have prioritized many of our critical bug fixes that impact the core gameplay pillars. In addition, we have added new decorative and build pieces highly requested by the community. 

Many of your requests have been heard - and to clarify, we are currently in discussion with regards to coop multiplayer and with an optional camera transition into first person mode. None of this is confirmed, but we wanted to make clear that your voices are heard, and we will continue evaluating. Localization efforts are currently underway for Russian and French languages. 

As always, thank you for supporting Noble Legacy, thanks for your patience and optimism - and we look forward to the next update in which we will announce soon along with our regularly scheduled hotfixes/patches. See you in Greenwood!


Highlights

 Resolved the 0/1 Visitors Bug 

 Addressed Hunger Issues with Visitors Eating/Drinking in Tavern

 Stone will now respawn, adjusted respawn on all resources

 Fixed Villager Homeless and Job Conflicts as a result of Upgrading Structures

 Fixed Settings Reset issues causing player FOV to set to 1

 Fixed Collection Radius resetting after a reload

 Fixed Roads disappearing after save and when a player initially equips the Destruction Hammer

 Fixed Villagers dropping sacks

 Building QOL, Snapping and a few new build parts for T3 Castle Set

Economy

 Increased daily tax cycles from 2 → 3. Villagers now pay full taxes each cycle.

 Increased season length.


AI & Villagers
 Multiple fixes to crafting and tavern-keeping behavior.

 Fixed Villagers depositing items and food-related storage logic.

 Villagers will always attempt to find a storehouse if one exists.

 Adjusted hunger system to sync directly to day cycle duration.

 Reintroduced behavior for eating from stew pots.

 Allowing villagers to hold onto food when dropping job-unrelated items.

 Fixed villagers not considering all storage options when searching.

 Adjusted Villager navigation logic.

 Villagers no longer wait excessively in leisure states and go home or go back to work

Building & Construction

 Fixed Prefabs not always placing all parts when placement was valid.

 Added flashing red indicator when placement is blocked.

 Fixed replace/upgrade system:

 Parts now properly replace instead of stacking.

 Refund notifications added when replacing parts.

 Resources refunded to inventory or global storage if full.

 Re-enabled build replace toggle in the menu.

 Fixed foundations not being replaced correctly.

 Fixed worker assignment issues when houses were destroyed.

 Added better support for non-gable roofs.

 Fixed roads disappearing after loading saves when using destruction tools.

 Build collisions added for stew pots and barrels.

 Updated building dimensions and alignment for consistency.

 Adjusted part widths to match correct tier sizes.


UI & UX

 Added upkeep cost and fuel/day info to build menu tooltips.

 Prevent saving prefabs without a name (with visual indicator).

 Fixed UI overlap issues with villager menus.

 Added functionality to override milestone completion messages.

 Tavern UI now shows stew availability across connected stew pots.

 Improved clarity of visitor limits in UI.

 Added button glow effect on berry marketplace quest.

 Updated clock visuals.

 Updated main menu visuals, lighting, and UI elements.


Gameplay & Systems

 Enabled regeneration of stones, trees, berries, mushrooms, etc.

 Chickens now produce eggs again.

 Added cooldown to scaling raid events.

 Added milestone: “Recruit 3 villagers” in sandbox mode.

 Fixed reliability of recruits in tutorial

 Market stalls now refresh properly on game start.

 Fixed tithe box intent.

 Fixed max visitors calculation.

 Improved visitor logic to better accommodate villages established away from spawn


Foliage & World

 Improved foliage hiding logic when placing build parts

 Non-ore foliage and resources can now be built over


Art & Visuals

 Updated castle materials and adjusted stone castle set (icons, pivots, gaps).

 Added new rugs and updated existing rug designs.

 Updated brick, stone foundation, trim, and floor materials.

 Added new food crafting icons (fish stew, mushroom stew).

 Tuned base materials, lighting, LUTs, and color grading for better visuals.

 Adjusted blocking volumes to prevent players leaving the map or building outside bounds.

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update & Community Spotlight!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/33a1c1ac17733f111b44332cdbc04bc2491a5aa6.png"]Weekly Development Update


As we wrap up our first week into Early Access, i'd like to thank you all for your support and continued feedback on Noble Legacy. This week, I wanted to share some development updates and the future of Noble Legacy.   Right now our primary focus is knocking out our hi priority bugs and features. We've had an overwhelming amount of feedback and have exposed certain issues we plan to address and will continue to do so. With your help we've been able to identify some critical issues, and take on feedback and requests for the high level vision of the game, which we are moving to action now. So thank you very much for keeping us accountable and assisting us as we trek forward in development.   



We have a significant patch coming soon with many changes, fixes and updates that were previously withheld to preserve the stability of the launch build. We are now rolling those changes in as we speak and testing internally and with our community focus testers on Discord.   Here are some of the top priorities for us in addressing. 

0/1 Visitors Bug - before visitors can visit your village, you must have at least 3 villagers and we've identified an issue that previously circumvented our last fix, reducing these issues from happening but have addressed it for visitor reliability.

Hunger Issues - This is our top priority at the moment along with the villagers dropping sacks of items. We are addressing this for this weeks patch and will provide more details in the notes to come. 

Cold Effects and Home Fueling - There are a few critical steps we are missing to communicate to the player how to properly fuel homes - which involves manually fueling along with villagers self fueling. We have some unfinished mechanics here that we will be addressing including manual build of a home fireplace and a more clear fueling flow. 

Build Snapping - Duplicates and Quality of Life - The T3 Castle Set which was slated in the roadmap was pushed early for testing at launch so that players had a wider array of build parts to work with. We're making improvements to the build system here, aligning build parts properly and addressing support issues. 

Players unable to create a new character/edit (no character creation screen) - We are presently overhauling the Main Menu, and its mechanics under the hood to be more reliable and to ensure character creation is executed on a new game. Reminder - once a character is created you can always edit via the edit character button in the menu and clothing changes in the wardrobe. 

Homeless and Job Assignments - We've identified an issue when deleting build parts for building classification that displays improper slots and boots villagers off jobs, with the workaround of reassignments. We'll be addressing this issue as well. 

General Bugs and Polish - based on reports as they come in we'll continue to address and many of the minor bugs are being corrected as we speak. 

Thanks again for your patience and support as we navigate through these issues to address. This has been a critical priority for us. We are also continuing on course in terms of progression and content. We have a lot more decorative and build parts to come along with some core mechanic changes and adjustments that will provide clear communication and proper research unlocks in respect to building tier categories.

notes.title: Noble Legacy - Early Access is now Live!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/b0458a918c88a7fb87bd15954983129dc156e8fa.png"]Lords, Ladies, and People of the Realm!
(yes, even the serfs, beggers, and ne'er do wells)


We are pleased to announce that Noble Legacy has now launched into Early Access and is available on Steam to download and play!

Noble Legacy early access launch features:
Campaign Tutorial - Want to learn the ropes? Embark on your first campaign journey in Greenwood along with your most beloved Uncle Edward. (Don’t let him bother you, too much).

Kingdom Mode - Establish your own village in the open world of Greenwood. Build, Collect Villagers, and create your own Fiefdom in our first 4km open world map. 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/c11560d6b843cbf84a5008ce4cf9cc1b8f433896.png"]

Collect Skilled Craftsmen

Attract the most valuable villagers in the land and turn them into loyal followers in your kingdom. Ensure their homes are properly furnished, entertainment is plentiful and provide cutting-edge tools to sustain their loyalty and boost their productivity. How many of the land’s greatest talents will you inspire to serve your cause?


Third-Person Kingdom Builder

Experience a deep kingdom management simulator elevated through a dynamic third-person perspective. Effortlessly toggle between a strategic top-down view to oversee and govern your realm, and an immersive third-person view to explore your lands, connect with your people, and build your kingdom’s future.


Steam Workshop Prefabs – Share your prefab creations with other Lords on the Steam Workshop! Rapidly grow your kingdom with pre-crafted buildings or meticulously design every structure to build a realm unlike any other. Save your unique creations and share them with fellow rulers through the Steam Workshop!


AI Villagers Collections & Simulation – Your people live, work, and interact autonomously - but as their Lord, your choices shape their fate. Optionally, you can expand on this with our Agentic AI Deep Conversation system. Inspired by the deep roleplay of classic text-based MUD games, Noble Legacy features a first-of-its-kind integration with OpenAI, bringing your villagers to life through real-time, unscripted conversation.


Economy Management / Fishing & Hunting 

Cultivate farms, gather from forests and waters, and harness resources to fuel a vibrant economy. Strategically develop production chains and allocate labor to create a flourishing kingdom. Amass wealth through trade, commerce, and lively entertainment, establishing your realm as the most preeminent economic hub in all the land.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/c11560d6b843cbf84a5008ce4cf9cc1b8f433896.png"]Roadmap

With much more exciting features to come, our team is excited to share future content and regular updates. Working hand in hand with our community, we invite you to join us on this journey together at 

https://discord.gg/jGA5PfqC8P


Thank you all for your support, and assisting us in getting us here. We are excited for the days to come and building this truly remarkable experience together.

notes.title: Early Access Launch Date
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/f9de4faf10bb35e6132fe739384f25525fdbcbf5.jpg"]

Noble Legacy – Early Access Launch Date Revealed

Lords and Ladies,

The time has come to raise your banners and ready your villages. We are excited to officially announce that Noble Legacy will enter Early Access at 10am PST on Steam this August 12th, 2025.

Set in a handcrafted medieval world, Noble Legacy invites you to shape the destiny of your people. Build, expand & upgrade your settlement, recruit & collect a variety of common to rare villagers, assign jobs, manage resources, build and share your work on Steam Workshop! Write your legacy through our open world Kingdom mode and try out our MUD inspired Deep Conversation Agentic AI system!

With a unique blend of strategic city-building, villager simulation, and deep player-driven storytelling, Noble Legacy

 aims to evolve with you. Your feedback will guide development as we continue to refine and expand the world and we look forward to sharing this journey with you all. If you’d like to participate, be sure to join our Discord at https://discord.com/invite/jGA5PfqC8P


[hr][/hr]

What to Expect in Early Access:
Core Building & Tiers – Plan, place, upgrade and expand your settlement from a humble village to a thriving hamlet and beyond!


Steam Workshop Prefabs – Share your prefab creations with other Lords on the Steam Workshop!


AI Villagers Collections & Simulation – Your people live, work, and interact autonomously—but as their Lord, your choices shape their fate. You can expand on this with our Agentic AI Deep Conversation system.


Agentic AI - Inspired by the deep roleplay of classic MUDs, Noble Legacy features a first-of-its-kind integration with OpenAI, bringing your villagers to life through real-time, unscripted conversation.


Tutorial - Want to learn the ropes? Embark on your first campaign journey in Greenwood along with your most beloved Uncle Edward. (Don’t let him bother you, too much)


Kingdom Mode – Carve your own path in our open world Kingdom Mode!


Global Inventory & Economy – Deep logistics and inventory management with a focus on immersion and realism. Assign and delegate your villagers to a variety of roles.


Seasonal Changes and Weather – Live through the seasons and adapt your strategies for the well being of your villagers. 
 
Roadmap & Beyond:
We have plans to add a significant amount of content as outlined in our roadmap. As always, join our Discord community to be involved with development as we look forward to interfacing with you all. Here are a few key features we're looking to add.


Hunters & Wildlife - Pastures & Shepherds - Husbandry - Fishing Minigame

Romance & Marriage - Gift Giving - Children - Expanded Relationships

Combat Expanded - Apothecary - Illness - Player Driven Event Raids - Diplomacy + More

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/e497a1528b4e69e99982ff866e873d3f792b382f.png"]


[hr][/hr]

Your Voice Matters
Early Access is just the beginning. We’re building this game with and for the community. We’ll be releasing regular updates, expanding systems like economy, combat, diplomacy, and more—based directly on your feedback.

Join our Discord, Wishlist on Steam, Your Legacy Awaits!


See you on August 12th.

— The Noble Legacy Team

notes.title: Demo Update – 1.0.0.53248
notes.content:
Demo Update Patch Notes – 1.0.0.53248

This patch includes major improvements across the board — from building and villager behavior to UI and performance. We've fixed crashes when starting a new game, resolved keybinding issues, overhauled build snapping, improved AI logic, cleaned up the tech tree, and delivered a ton of quality-of-life improvements. Expect a smoother, more intuitive experience with added polish and greater stability.

[hr][/hr]Key Fixes & Features
Players should no longer crash when clicking New on the main menu

Rebinding arrow keys should no longer interrupt movement

[hr][/hr]

Gameplay & Systems
Villagers now eat properly to resolve hunger/starvation

Crafting now works with the Tavern Keeping job

Campaign now continues properly after the church quest (matches Sandbox behavior)

Hunger now impacts morale more fairly (decay timing fixed)

Morale from bad weather reduced (less punishing)

New recruits gain a temporary morale boost

Grumpy trait penalty reduced (from -10 to -5)

Trait updates:

"Lazy" trait replaced with a new version

Temporary "Intelligent" trait added

Trait effects now correctly apply when reassigned

Beds are now only usable when villagers are in the rest state

Building types now apply proper tags to the kingdom system

Challenge timers increased to give players more breathing room
[hr][/hr]

AI & Villagers
Improved idle behavior and movement logic

Increased AI timeout duration to reduce stuck states

AI avoids reloading hand-placed characters

Villagers no longer require upkeep unless morale drops below 20

Tier 1 and Tier 2 villagers now have short descriptions

Fixed AI walking under stairs and clipping through pews


[hr][/hr]

Build System & Placement
Reworked snapping system:

Toggle between None, Small (25), and Large (50)

Removed CTRL + Scroll snap distance adjustment

UI now shows snap modes instead of distances

Fixed buildings merging or shifting positions unexpectedly

Building upgrades now preserve custom names

Dining tables no longer float

Structure part replacement re-enabled (toggle with 'Y')

Fixed trace bug when switching camera views

Extended roof weather-blocking volumes

Disabled Niagara components during placement

Fixed collision issues on some doors and pews

Weather-blocking volumes can no longer be altered in packaged builds

Tables now contribute correctly to housing requirements

Build menu now displays locked items

Clay and iron ore now appear in the storehouse UI (not stored by default)

Gables rescaled and better aligned with roofs

[hr][/hr]

UI & User Experience
Build “Replace Mode” checkbox replaced with clear On/Off labels

Storehouse menus fully synced and unified

Market menu item info is now consistent across all menus

Scenario menu and text updated

Added "Edit Character" button to main menu

Snap mode toggle feedback added to build input overlay

Keybind added for structure replacement toggle

Quit warning now shows time since last save

Load button added to the main menu

Dialogue menus improved in story sequences

ESC key now attempts to close dialogue (work in progress)

Fixed UI issues during story events and character renaming

Improved text clipping, alignment, and button interaction

Character limits added to building name fields

Tech tree split into multiple pages for easier navigation

Updated visuals for GenAI menus

Reorganized and cleaned up research UI

Research nodes now properly reflect kingdom tier requirements
[hr][/hr]

Tech Tree & Research
Fixed various broken nodes and navigation issues

"Weapons Rack" renamed to "Hunting Weapons"

Forager’s basket added to starting research in campaign

Forager research now displays the correct icon

Nodes now unlock even if tier requirements are not present

Tithe box behavior corrected

Research now saves and loads properly

Added "UnlockAllResearch" cheat command


[hr][/hr]Inventory & Items
Player now starts with a sword

Harvest task radius increased from 50m to 300m

Fixed previously unstackable items now stacking correctly

Fixed highlight lingering after unequipping the hammer

[hr][/hr]Save & Load System
Save system now uses local time

Improved both manual and auto-save workflows

Added "Reset All Settings" button

Fixed disappearing video settings panel

Storehouse item limits now saved

Autosaves now labeled clearly and separated



Load screen now shows detailed save metadata

Fixed infinite loop when placing weapon racks

Fixed load issues with hand-placed AI and roads

[hr][/hr]Controls & Input
Snap mode toggle now works while holding the hammer

Gamepad type (Xbox/PlayStation) now detected dynamically
[hr][/hr]
Visuals & Art
Rebuilt maps for improved performance and lighting

Applied weather effects to stone foundations and floors

Reduced forest berry bush density by ~25% (meadow density unchanged)

Fixed prefab lighting that appeared too dark at night

Missing furniture restored in campaign home

Optimized lights like campfires and candles

Re-enabled weather effects and improved time-of-day visuals

Optimized texture memory

notes.title: Noble Legacy - Community Update
notes.content:
Noble Legacy - Community Update

An updated demo is now live! We've spent the week fixing bugs, adding new content, and improving core systems. Here's what’s new:

Game/Demo Updates
Female Characters added to Character Creation Menu

Updated Demo now live with new content and improvements  

Fixes addressing bugs, polish, and overall stability  

Performance improvements across the board for smoother gameplay  

Sandbox Mode improvements for better creative freedom and control 

Research Tree overhaul – redesigned for clarity and progression flow  

AI Villager improvements – smarter behaviors, better pathing, and job handling  

Building System improvements – cleaner placement, better snapping, and feedback  

New road placement controls – more precise and user-friendly  

Economy balancing – refined trade, income, and resource flow  

Save reliability improvements – we've made adjustments to improve stability; any reports or confirmations from the community are extremely helpful 
Coming Soon
We are officially confirming German Localization (Wir bestätigen offiziell die deutsche Lokalisierung.)

EA Launch - EA Launch has originally been slated for late July but has been set a few weeks back to early August. 


Community UpdatesIntroducing: The Noble Council
A new community testing group helping us find bugs, refine mechanics, and improve the overall experience. They have also been assisting our team in testing the reliability of Workshop integration as well as player to developer feedback and suggestions. If this is a program you'd be interested in participating please join our Discord Community at https://discord.com/invite/jGA5PfqC8P

Community Contributions! 
We have some fantastic builds that we are excited to share created by the fine folks in The Noble Council. 

The Laughing Gnoll - by Megan (Onyx)

Cozy fire? Check. Questionable stew made from “local mushrooms”? Double check. Five rooms upstairs if you’ve had one too many meads, and stalls out back for your horse—or your mother-in-law.

Whether you're here for the gossip, the ale, or just to escape the weather, The Laughing Gnoll has you covered. Just don’t ask why it’s laughing. Seriously. Don’t.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/46e8342601c50bddb0541dbcab0e2114295ea89b.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/6659ced1846198fbf07154b4817b92eaf246fe6f.jpg"]

The Kings Cross Inn by Kingsmen
A quaint 1 story flat Inn that sits at the crossroads, makes this a comfortable spot for any traveler looking to lay their head for the night!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/656833e5efb8c1cdfef1bbbce59c6536200d6640.png"]
Hybrid Tavern and Stables by Kate Kaplan


Crafted by the talented Kate Kaplan, this brilliantly chaotic prefab—formerly known as the modestly named Tavern Stable Hybrid—has been lovingly transformed into what we now call The Prancing Potato.

Equal parts bar, inn, and stable, it’s the kind of place where you can grab a drink, crash for the night, and park your horse—all without stepping outside. From fancy guest rooms for the coin-heavy traveler to budget bunks for the thrifty, there's something here for everyone.

Food? Yes. Furniture? Tons. Charm? Unquestionable. Come for the ale, stay for the potatoes... they might even dance.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/6375fbbc787063fa59a0a78c857e8918fb2e3c9e.png"]

Thanks for your continued support. If you are interested in Noble Legacy, we appreciate your support, follow the game and add to your wishlist!



Stay tuned — more to come!
